records.reviewReason: The matched item is the multi-campus Indiana University system, and the name alone does not say whether the doctorate came from Bloomington or another IU campus. Second reviewer: Q6608367 is the multi-campus IU system, and 'Indiana University' is its official name. The flagship's official name is 'Indiana University Bloomington' (Q1079140). Other campuses such as Indianapolis also award doctorates, so the bare name does not single out Bloomington. Leaving it ambiguous, with no item and no sameAs, is the conservative choice.
